entities.name: Conrad Willgerodt
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Conrad Heinrich Christoph Willgerodt was a German chemist who first described the Willgerodt reaction. Alongside the Willgerodt reaction, he had also discovered Iodosobenzene and chlorobutanol and several nitrophenol ethers.
